stem: What happens next in this passage after “At the end of the week, the teacher asked what they had learned.”?
options: One day, visitors from another school came and said, "Your bell is beautiful."
The teacher came in and said she had hidden the box for one day.
Andy said small things were not small if he bought them every day.
By the end of the day, they reached every place on the plan.
